speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are highly suggestive of *Listeria monocytogenes*. Given your pregnancy status and the normal lumbar puncture, we can rule out meningitis. Have you consumed any unpasteurized dairy products, cold deli meats, or soft cheeses recently?
